body.statement: For the two-period panel difference-in-differences model under conditional parallel trends and overlap, Sant'Anna and Zhao's Proposition 1(a), equations (2.11)--(2.12), give the semiparametric efficiency bound and the efficient influence function for the average treatment effect on the treated.

source.verbatim_statement: the efficient influence function for the ATT is ... and the semiparametric efficiency bound for all regular estimators for the ATT is

attestation.note: Primary author copy at https://psantanna.com/files/SantAnna_Zhao_DRDID.pdf, Proposition 1(a): equation (2.11) displays the panel EIF and equation (2.12) its semiparametric efficiency bound.
